scope: Second foundation slice. Versioned JSON profile export/import is implemented and automated. Full C acceptance remains OPEN: nested/tabbed dock groups, floating panels, dynamic dock zones and complete cross-session/workspace lifecycle acceptance remain unimplemented or unverified.

source_control.runtime_message: feat(editor): import and export workspace profiles
source_control.push: Normal fast-forward push verified with git ls-remote and GitHub compare; branch ahead 1 / behind 0 from previous_head.

implementation.export: Selected local profile is serialized as bounded JSON and downloaded with a sanitized filename.
implementation.import: JSON schema/version are checked; existing workspace-profile allowlist normalization strips unrecognized fields; IDs are regenerated locally; profiles are never applied automatically.
implementation.rejection: Malformed, oversized, unsupported-version, duplicate-name and over-limit profiles are rejected without overwriting existing profiles.
implementation.history: Import is included in local workspace Undo/Redo.
implementation.mobile: 320 CSS px layout is checked for horizontal overflow and 44px minimum touch targets.
implementation.external_benchmark: No additional package/code introduced; the plan-recorded Dockview source/license review continues to justify native, bounded serialization for the existing three-region vanilla-JS shell.
